question: Where are Vasudhā and Śrī situated in relation to the lord of wealth?
premises: The location is in front of the lord of wealth.
They are there on their own seat.
The deities are Vasudhā and Śrī.
inference: Vasudhā and Śrī are seated on their own seat in front of the lord of wealth.
plain_english: There, in front of the lord of wealth, Vasudhā and Śrī are seated on their own seat.
